label: Grok 4.7 run 2 - reasoning effort high, uncapped output
notes: Run 2 of 3 and the best of the three. 90 findings, one penalty. Adds D6 (no air-barrier connection at roof-to-wall 4/A4.11 and 6/A4.12) and G8 (1/4":12 below the SnapLock 450 range) to run 1's coverage. C8 is 1.0, the only full C8 this round: F-4 says dry-laid SS-3 at the path, patio and ramp has no setting assembly and the only exterior stone assembly is thinset, which is the unspecified-installation-method defect. Spot-check this one, because it calls the ramp dry-laid when the plan says wet-laid. C6 is 0.5: D-2 contrasts the drawn 1/4":12 with the spec's single 3":12, but names only one of the unaddressed slopes. Partials: C5 0.5 (R-63 misread again); E5 0.5 (missing cable spacing, cited at the exterior stairs rather than the pool barrier); E7 0.5 (hedged, '5/8" Type X if any habitable room bears on that ceiling'); G9 0.5 (the 'verify in field' note is cited for the driveway, with setback mentioned only generally); G16 0.5 (names the right walls but says 'no wall type ... shows that treatment', and W-3 is defined on A4.00; same call as Opus 5.5 run 2). The penalty is I8, stated three times (A-5, B-1, E-1). Its south-pool-edge finding accepts the edge as intentionally open and asks for the wall height, so it is not penalized. 14 server-side PDF tool calls. cost_usd is the runner's PRICING calculation, as recorded in the manifest; xAI's own usage.cost_in_usd_ticks reports $2.10 for this run. Misses: A2, A3, B1, B4-B6, C7, C9, D1, D3, F1, F2, F4, G1-G3, G10, G13.

incorrect.claim: B-1 / E-1: Ten equal risers between 508'-0" and 518'-0" require 12" risers; a single flight of 10 risers in a 10'-0" story exceeds the residential maximum.
incorrect.why: Known Incorrect Findings entry I8: the stair has 18 risers across two runs (10 east + 8 south) at about 6-11/16", which is compliant. Treating one run as the whole 10'-0" story is the single-run misread. Stated at Certain. Also restated in A-5; penalized once.

categories.label: Schedule-to-Drawing
categories.desc: Door and window schedule entries that conflict with what is drawn on plans or elevations — wrong widths, wrong materials, wrong finishes for the assigned room.

categories.label: Dimensional / Geometric
categories.desc: Dimension discrepancies between sheets, conflicting datums, wall assembly totals that don't match their component layers, and missing code-critical dimensions.

categories.label: Spec-to-Drawing Conflicts
categories.desc: Conflicts between the project specifications and the drawn documents — different products, different quantities, different performance requirements, different assembly configurations.

categories.label: Building Envelope
categories.desc: Vapor control, air barrier continuity, insulation placement and values, flashing details, and whether wall and roof assemblies perform appropriately for the project climate.

categories.label: Code and Life Safety
categories.desc: Egress paths, minimum door and railing dimensions, fire separation requirements, makeup air for exhaust systems, and other conditions requiring code compliance.

categories.label: Constructability
categories.desc: Whether details can physically be built as drawn — door swing clearances, missing flashing, system conflicts, and architectural elements that require coordination not shown.

categories.label: Completeness and Clarity
categories.desc: Missing tags, orphaned keynotes, TBD items that prevent accurate bidding, dead cross-references, deferred design decisions, and annotations that are ambiguous or absent.
